text:
carmen: Quick kickoff for StratusFabric joint perf bench next week. Goal: energy_per_token (J), sustained tokens/s, and one kernel micro-tune pass in their secure rack. Need owners for matrix, telemetry contract, and canary plan.

 diego: I'll put together a compact matrix: models redwood-1.5b/redwood-7b, quants fp16/int8, batches 1/4/8, seq 256/1024, runs=3. Important to capture chassis_power_w, node_power_w, tokens_total, p99_ms, energy_j_per_token.

 hana: I can own telemetry schema and the consolidated CSV. Will include peak_gpu_mem, kv_peak_bytes, pdu_status. Export path s3://partners/stratus/3712345678/.

 li: I'll extend the Prom exporter with labels lab,rack,node,model,quant,batch,seq,run. Metrics: chassis_power_w,node_power_w,gpu_power_w,tokens_total,latency_ms_bucket,kv_peak_bytes. Example PromQL for energy per token (1m):

 sum(rate(chassis_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))

 carmen: Kernel tuning plan: baseline -> micro-tune -> safety check -> final. StratusFabric requires kernel blobs to stay in their environment; legal cleared coop NDA but no binaries leave. They asked for a 1-page rollback annex.

 diego: Standard run command for runbook:

 ./benchstratus --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --iters 3 --warmup 12 --chassis-measure --out s3://partners/stratus/3712345678/

 bench-bot: Smoke CI: 3 runs attempted; 1 failed due to pdu read transient on node n3. Logs: s3://bench/stratus/3712345678/logs.tar.gz. Issue #8120 created.

 hana: Noted PDU flake. Will add pdu_retry and kv_flush between iterations. CSV columns: run_id,model,quant,batch,seq,avg_gpu_w,node_w,chassis_w,tokens_s,p99_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_gpu_mem,kv_peak_bytes,pdu_status.

 li: I'll add peak_power_w and emit a rate-corrected energy_j_per_token gauge. Also include an example alert: energy_j_per_token > baseline * 1.2.

 maria: Marketing will draft a short marketplace blurb after canary sign-off. We'll need partner quote and lab-signed numbers. I'll prepare the template for the quote.

 carmen: Action items: diego matrix + runbook PR (today), hana telemetry schema (EOD), li exporter changes (tomorrow AM), maria draft blurb template (EOD). Weekly sync set for Friday 3712345878 to decide canary timing. Thanks all.

 bench-bot: Created GH issue #8120 "StratusFabric energy/token + micro-tune" and scheduled weekly sync Friday 3712345878.
